title: The Miniature River Branch Complete

features.name: the-complete-shelter
features.desc-on-touch: a small structure stands where the tributary bends; it contains everything a house needs, scaled down and yet complete. someone lived here once, or is living here still at a scale you cannot quite perceive

features.name: the-tributary-whole
features.desc-on-touch: water moves like the great river, but everything it carries—every stone, every current, every memory of flow—is proportioned to infinite miniature. you know at once this branch contains the entire system

features.name: the-fractal-circuit
features.desc-on-touch: a board here maps the branch's path but its traces follow the exact meanders of the water. magnify the pattern and you see the same shape recurring at every scale of inspection

features.name: the-tributary-witness
features.desc-on-touch: something moves in the water that knows it is miniature and also infinite; its movements trace the same patterns as the river miles upstream and downstream simultaneously

features.name: branch-catalogue
features.desc-on-touch: a standing directory lists this tributary's contents as if it were a folder: stones, currents, one kept letter, a time of day that happens nowhere else, the weight of something almost decided

inscription: infinity is just another name for a river learning to see itself whole in a single branch

file.name: Tributary_Fractal_Map_Scale_Approaches_Itself.svg
file.note: ERROR: archive has exceeded witness — map contains an exit; water flows both upstream and downstream; the branch insists it is both inlet and source. cartography uncertain
